name: Sproutle
notes: Sproutle: a seedling hatching from its tan seed coat, with a two-leaf sprout on its head. Type GRASS. Moves: Vine Whip (A), Razor Leaf (B) and Solar Beam (R). Walks at 80 % speed: its move 1 (Vine Whip) reaches 3 tiles, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. Its moves hit 10 % softer than their power says (power 90 %), whether it is the player or a wild one, in every mode. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: SPROUTLE
